seasons.name: The Awakening of Chen Nan
seasons.overview: The book is based on the protagonist Chen Nan's search for his lover Yu Xin ten thousand years ago and the pursuit of the secrets of the destruction of gods and demons. It leads to the vast six paths and the chess game of heaven and earth, and interprets a legend full of blood, heroism, and poignant beauty. It tells the legends of countless heroes and beauties, and discusses elements such as human nature, society, and life.

episodes.name: Wings of Defiance
episodes.overview: Chen Nan awakens latent powers tied to his destiny, drawing the attention of divine forces.

episodes.name: Gates of Shenlan
